run_awa2_handler: run the awa2_handler function to import the AWA2 dataset from a local zip file path
read_classes_with_labels: read class names and their integer labels from a classes.txt file inside a zipfile
read_classes_without_labels: read class names without labels from a trainclasses.txt or testclasses.txt file inside a zipfile
read_attributes_matrix: read binary or continuous predicate attribute matrices from a zipfile using a custom encoding function
download_awa2_dataset: download the AWA2 dataset from the IST Austria URL using the awa2_dataset DownloadableArtefact definition
